purpose: Reviewer-targeted robustness and falsification analyses for the Imaging Neuroscience manuscript

C1_phase_null.description: At each complex field coordinate, keep every category amplitude exactly fixed and independently permute the four category phases in the two compared halves.

C2_random_basis.description: Fixed random orthogonal rotations of the same K=16 graph-mode subspace; same rotation is applied to all runs and participants within a null replicate.

C2_oob_pca.description: For each disjoint 2-vs-2 partition, fit a KxK PCA rotation on the unused fifth run only, then apply that basis to both evaluated halves.

C2_sensor_coordinate.description: Rank-matched sensor-coordinate reconstruction from the frozen first 16 graph modes using the frozen graph eigenvectors; not a full 102-mode/raw-sensor analysis.

C3_far_prestim.description: Repeat the frozen identity-basis alpha pipeline in a matched 200-ms far-prestimulus window [-450,-250] ms and compare participant-level reliability with 50-250 ms poststimulus.

C4_metric_robustness.description: Re-evaluate FULL/AP/AMP RDM reliability under three association metrics without changing the neural representation.

interpretation_guardrail: These controls use cohorts whose primary SGIT outcomes are already known. They are frozen robustness/falsification analyses, not a new prospective confirmation cohort and not evidence of consciousness specificity or causality.
